name: Project Hot Wife
source:
The story revolves around a couple in their 30's and what life throws at them.
You will encounter there changing lifestyle and desires.
The player will portrait both spouses with the heavier emphasis on the wife.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/PHWAMM]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一对30多岁的夫妻展开，讲述生活将什么抛向他们。

你会经历他们不断变化的生活方式与欲望。

玩家将分别扮演两位配偶，重点放在妻子身上。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/PHWAMM]Patreon[/url]]
